## Before you ask for review

- [ ] `php artisan test` passes locally
- [ ] Migrations were **added**, not edited — a merged migration is never changed
- [ ] If the schema changed, the seeder was updated in the same PR
- [ ] If a number in `README.md` or `docs/ISSUES.md` changed, it was updated here too
- [ ] No `.env`, no credentials, no `database.sqlite` committed
- [ ] The issue is assigned to me on GitHub
